echo.inventory.title: Echo Freight · Loadout
echo.inventory.tool_help.0: Fixed slot. Interceptors charge the cutter; other factions keep an empty hand to gather, deliver or rescue by holding Use.
echo.inventory.tool_help.1: Fixed slot. Supports an equipped card. You can also select a card in hotbar slots 4–9 and right-click directly.
echo.inventory.tool_help.2: Fixed slot. Hold the token and right-click to cast your active specialization. See the skill HUD for cooldowns.
echo.inventory.fixed_help: Fixed tool: selectable, but cannot be moved, swapped, dropped or placed in the offhand.
echo.inventory.empty_slot: Empty supply slot: select a supply, then click here to move it.
echo.inventory.stack_help: Two separate packs share this slot. Left-click selects the first; right-click selects the second.
echo.inventory.use_help: Cast on yourself. Consumed only after server confirmation.
echo.inventory.hold_help: Close inventory and hold this supply. Aim and right-click; two-point cards require two target clicks.
echo.inventory.craft_help: Shift-click a second base card in the same series, then confirm the preview.
echo.inventory.select_help: Shift-click a second card to craft; click an empty slot to move a supply.
echo.inventory.invalid_recipe: These supplies cannot combine. Choose base cards from the same series.
echo.inventory.empty_detail:
Select supplies below to view, use or open them.
Three fixed tools and six supply slots share your hotbar. There is no extra bag.
Shift-click two base cards to preview crafting.
echo.inventory.close_help: %s / ESC: close · Number keys: select · Right-click supplies to use
echo.inventory.draft.title: Supply pack · Pick one
echo.inventory.draft.choose_help: Keep one card · Closing does not reroll choices
echo.inventory.draft.cancel_help: Cancel / close to interrupt. Generated choices never reroll.
echo.inventory.request.timeout: Request timed out. Resyncing, not repeating the action.
echo.inventory.request.unavailable: Failed: inventory unavailable. Reopen your bag.
echo.inventory.request.syncing: Not sent: waiting for rules and inventory sync.
echo.inventory.request.busy: Not sent: previous request awaits confirmation.
